howto.what_en: Claude applies CQRS patterns: it separates command and query paths, writes command and query handlers, and updates read models from events. Concrete templates and worked examples are in references/details.md.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you separate read and write models, scale reads independently from writes, build event-sourced systems, or need different read/write data models.
